legend.0: 0 broken — missing skills, broken frontmatter, package/README mismatch, or unloadable
legend.1: 1 prototype — skills present but thin contracts, inconsistent metadata, weak companions/docs
legend.2: 2 RC solid — eleven skills consistent with pi.skills + README + tests; clear authority; minor polish gaps OK
legend.3: 3 production-complete — exemplary skill pack with no meaningful packaging/discoverability/contract gaps

legend.0: 0 broken — missing/corrupt workflow assets or checksum mismatch
legend.1: 1 prototype — docs exist but authority/onboarding/validation contracts incomplete or ambiguous
legend.2: 2 RC solid — clear work shapes, preparation, document authority, validation/completion, recovery; hashes match
legend.3: 3 production-complete — exhaustive operator-ready workflow with no material ambiguity

legend.0: 0 contradicted — skills/workflow conflict with extension tools or safety model
legend.1: 1 partial — mostly aligned but important tool/authority gaps or contradictions
legend.2: 2 RC solid — consistent prepare/finalize/plan authority; minor wording gaps OK
legend.3: 3 exemplary — skills and workflow perfectly encode extension contracts
